name: UPMC Health Plan - UPMC for Life (Medicare Advantage)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public upmchealthplan.com pages only (no sign-in). Online methods are not stated (bank and card assumed from the phone and in-person options; inferred). The page lists no pay-without-signing-in option, so guest pay is modelled unsupported (inferred). UPMC for Life Go paperless page: online delivery of ANOC, Summary of Benefits, EOC, formulary, provider directory and member guide via Preference Center ('Update My Preferences') or app Account > Preferences > Communications; hard copies continue unless you opt in; UPMC for Life members 1-877-539-3080 (TTY 711), Oct 1-Mar 31 seven days 8-8, Apr 1-Sep 30 Mon-Fri 8-8. Sign-in identifier (username) is inferred. Review (tier-20): the UPMC for Life welcome page confirms recurring premium autopay at the same menu paths, the member line 1-877-539-3080 and the login Help Desk 1-800-937-0438.

Welcome, UPMC for Life Members | UPMC Health Plan

pay_online.note: Sign in and go to Spending and Billing, then Premium Payments. Pay by the due date on your invoice to keep your coverage.

guest_pay.note: Online payments need your UPMC Health Plan login. You can also pay 24/7 with no fee by calling the number on your member ID card and pressing 1.

autopay.note: Sign up on the member site under Spending and Billing, Premium Payments, or in the app under Account Hub, Manage Premium Payments.

paperless.note: Choose online delivery of plan documents in the Preference Center. Printed copies keep coming unless you opt in.

pay_by_phone.note: Call the toll-free number on your member ID card and press 1. Available 24/7 with no fee; check, debit or credit card.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check or money order with the subscriber's member ID to UPMC Health Plan, PO Box 371842, Pittsburgh, PA 15250-7842.

help.title: How to pay your bill
paragraphs: Pay by the due date on your invoice to keep your coverage month to month.

Online: sign in to the member site and go to Spending and Billing, then Premium Payments. In the UPMC Health Plan app, go to Account Hub, then Manage Premium Payments, and confirm your email and payment information.
By phone: call the toll-free number on your member ID card and press 1 for the automated payment system. It is open 24/7, there is no wait and no fee, and it takes check, debit or credit card.
In person at a UPMC Health Plan Connect Center with a debit or credit card or an electronic check.

help.title: Paying by mail
paragraphs: Send a check or money order with the subscriber's member ID number written on it to UPMC Health Plan, PO Box 371842, Pittsburgh, PA 15250-7842.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: Sign up for autopay with your UPMC Health Plan login. On the member site go to Spending and Billing, then Premium Payments; in the app go to Account Hub, then Manage Premium Payments.
Need a login? Register for a UPMC Health Plan Login first. If you forgot your user ID or need help signing in, call the Help Desk at 1-800-937-0438.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: UPMC for Life members can get the Annual Notice of Changes, Summary of Benefits, Evidence of Coverage, formulary, provider directory and member guide online. On the member site choose Update My Preferences, pick your materials and how to be notified (email, or email and text), and keep the toggle on. In the app tap Account, Preferences, then Communications.
If you do nothing, printed copies keep coming by mail. Questions? Call 1-877-539-3080 (TTY 711).

extra.intent: Using UPMC Health Plan's payment help, find the P.O. box number to mail your UPMC for Life premium check to. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using UPMC Health Plan's payment help, find which number you press after calling the number on your member ID card to reach the automated payment system. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
